questions.stemText: A ball is projected off a cliff horizontally with velocity $v$. It lands on the ground a time $t$ later at a distance $d$ from the foot of the cliff as shown. Air resistance is negligible. [Diagram: ball at the top edge of a vertical cliff moving horizontally with velocity $v$; it lands at distance $d$ from the foot of the cliff.] If a heavier ball is projected off the same cliff with the same velocity, which row is correct for the heavier ball? (time to land; distance from foot of cliff) A $t$; $d$ B $t$; less than $d$ C less than $t$; $d$ D less than $t$; less than $d$

questions.difficultyReason: Standard idea that projectile motion without air resistance is independent of mass.

explanation.body:
Without air resistance, the only force is weight, so the acceleration is $g$ for any mass.

Vertical motion from the same height with zero initial vertical velocity gives the same time $t$; horizontal velocity $v$ is unchanged, so the range $d = vt$ is the same.

perOption.A: Correct. Mass does not affect the motion when air resistance is negligible.
perOption.B: The horizontal velocity is the same and there is no horizontal force, so the range does not decrease.
perOption.C: Acceleration is $g$ regardless of mass, so the heavier ball does not fall faster.
perOption.D: Both time and distance are independent of mass; this assumes heavier objects fall faster.
